panels.title: Distinct users

targets.expr: sum by (userId) (count_over_time({app="norppa", environment="$environment"} |= `"url":"/api/login"` | pattern `<_>"userId":"<userId>"<_>` | userId!="" | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | ts >= $__from | drop ts [$__interval]))

panels.description: Users who loaded the app. Shibboleth logins only. Leaves out users seen only today (UTC) until midnight, so ranges of a day or two come out low.

panels.title: New features distinct users

targets.expr: sum by (userId, feature) (count_over_time({app="norppa", environment="$environment"} |= `"responseTime"` !~ `"url": ?"/api/(noad/)?ping` |~ `"url":"/api/(user-guide/opened|help-chatbot/turns)` | json method, url, status, responseTime, userId, userAgent | method="POST" | url=~"/api/(user-guide/opened|help-chatbot/turns)/?([?].*)?" | status < 400 | __error__="" | userId!="" | label_format feature=`{{ if hasPrefix "/api/user-guide" .url }}User guide{{ else }}NorppAI{{ end }}` | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | ts >= $__from | drop ts [$__interval]))

panels.description: User guide: users who opened it. NorppAI: users who asked a question.

panels.title: Active users per day

targets.expr: count(sum by (userId) (count_over_time({app="norppa", environment="$environment"} |= `"url":"/api/login"` | pattern `<_>"userId":"<userId>"<_>` | userId!="" | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | ts >= $__from | drop ts [$__interval])))

panels.description: Days are UTC. Today shows up after midnight UTC.

panels.title: Feature usage over time

targets.expr: sum by (feature) (count_over_time({app="norppa", environment="$environment"} |= `"responseTime"` !~ `"url": ?"/api/(noad/)?ping` |~ `"method":"(POST|PUT)"` | json method, url, status, responseTime, userId, userAgent | label_format path=`{{ trimSuffix "/" (regexReplaceAll "[?].*" .url "") }}` | label_format feature=`{{ if eq .method "POST" }}{{ if eq .path "/api/feedbacks" }}Feedback given{{ else if eq .path "/api/noad/feedbacks" }}Feedback given (non-AD){{ else if and (hasPrefix "/api/continuous-feedback/" .path) (contains "/response/" .path) }}Continuous feedback replies{{ else if hasPrefix "/api/continuous-feedback/" .path }}Continuous feedback sent{{ else if eq .path "/api/norppa-feedback" }}Norppa feedback sent{{ end }}{{ else if eq .method "PUT" }}{{ if and (hasPrefix "/api/standalone-surveys/answer/" .path) (hasSuffix "/response" .path) }}Standalone survey answers{{ end }}{{ end }}` | feature!="" | status < 400 | __error__="" | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | ts >= $__from | drop ts [$__interval]))

sum(count_over_time({app="norppa", environment="$environment"} |= `type = 'Notify students about counter feedback'` | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | ts >= $__from | drop ts [$__interval]))

panels.description: Successful requests per interval. Counter feedback counts the ones sent with the email to students.

panels.description: Summed from the chart on the left. Features without use in the range are left out. Counter feedback saved without the email to students is not counted.

panels.title: Endpoints

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({app="norppa", environment="$environment"} |= `"responseTime"` !~ `"url": ?"/api/(noad/)?ping` | json method, url, responseTime | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/[^/]*[0-9][^/]*" (regexReplaceAll "[?].*" .url "") "/:id" }}` | label_format endpoint=`{{ .method }} {{ .path }}` | drop method, url, path | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | ts >= $__from | drop ts [$__interval])), "metric", "requests", "", "")

label_replace(sum by (endpoint) (sum_over_time({app="norppa", environment="$environment"} |= `"responseTime"` !~ `"url": ?"/api/(noad/)?ping` | json method, url, responseTime | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/[^/]*[0-9][^/]*" (regexReplaceAll "[?].*" .url "") "/:id" }}` | label_format endpoint=`{{ .method }} {{ .path }}` | drop method, url, path | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | ts >= $__from | drop ts | unwrap responseTime | __error__="" [$__interval])), "metric", "time", "", "")

label_replace(sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({app="norppa", environment="$environment"} |= `"responseTime"` !~ `"url": ?"/api/(noad/)?ping` |= `"status":"5` | json method, url, responseTime | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/[^/]*[0-9][^/]*" (regexReplaceAll "[?].*" .url "") "/:id" }}` | label_format endpoint=`{{ .method }} {{ .path }}` | drop method, url, path | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | ts >= $__from | drop ts [$__interval])), "metric", "errors", "", "")

panels.description: Path segments containing a digit are collapsed to :id. Average instead of a percentile, because percentiles can't be added up from the hourly pieces Loki can split into.

panels.title: Users by device

targets.expr: sum by (userId, device) (count_over_time({app="norppa", environment="$environment"} |= `"url":"/api/login"` | pattern `<_>"userId":"<userId>"<_>` | userId!="" | label_format device=`{{ if contains "Mobi" __line__ }}Mobile{{ else }}Desktop{{ end }}` | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | ts >= $__from | drop ts [$__interval]))

panels.description: A user on both counts in both. Leaves out users seen only today (UTC) until midnight, so ranges of a day or two come out low.
